issue.title: [SPARK-17379] [BUILD] Upgrade netty-all to 4.0.41 final for bug fixes

repository.name: spark
repository.description: Apache Spark - A unified analytics engine for large-scale data processing

issue.body:
## What changes were proposed in this pull request?

Upgrade netty-all to latest in the 4.0.x line which is 4.0.41, mentions several bug fixes and performance improvements we may find useful, see netty.io/news/2016/08/29/4-0-41-Final-4-1-5-Final.html. Initially tried to use 4.1.5 but noticed it's not backwards compatible.
## How was this patch tested?

Existing unit tests against branch-1.6 and branch-2.0 using IBM Java 8 on Intel, Power and Z architectures

body: @zsxwing so you want to have a way to completely empty the pool ?

@zsxwing actually I think the more correct solution would be to ensure that all buffers in the `PooledByteBufAllocator` are released when the `PooledByteBufAllocator` is collected. Does this sound correct ?
@zsxwing I think this should fix it: https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/5847
